stepTitle: Define Read Only Reference Sandbox Copy Policy
description: Pins the read-only reference sandbox copy policy used by oracle-capture runs: source root, sandbox parent directory, sandbox name prefix, required and excluded file sets with their SHA-256 hashes and roles, hash verification, cleanup, and mutable-config copy flags. The doom/ source tree must never be mutated during a run; instead, every oracle-capture run snapshots a sandbox under workspaceRoot/sandboxParent/sandboxPrefix<id>/ and writes there.
